name: t3-clone
title: T3 Code clone
description: An IDE-style agent workspace in the style of T3 Code: thread sidebar, streaming conversation with a composer that flies from centre to dock, resizable terminal dock, and a surface panel (browser, terminal, files, diff, agents). Docks everything on desktop, slides the panel in as a drawer on tablets, and moves to a hamburger sidebar, bottom tab bar and snap-sheet terminal on phones. Composed from the WorkbenchShell, thread sidebar, conversation, terminal and surface primitives.
